name: get_bar_forces
author: hprebar
title: Get bar internal forces
description: Extracts internal forces (FX, FY, FZ, MX, MY, MZ) along a specified bar at N relative points (0.0 = start, 1.0 = end).

barNumber.description: Bar number to extract forces for.

pointsCount.description: Number of calculation points along the bar length.
